documentation.usageCode:
import {
  AutocompleteRoot,
  AutocompleteLabel,
  AutocompleteControl,
  AutocompleteInput,
  AutocompleteClear,
  AutocompletePositioner,
  AutocompleteContent,
  AutocompleteItem,
  AutocompleteEmpty,
} from '@uifn/components-react/autocomplete'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <AutocompleteRoot items={[{"id":"item-1","value":"item-1","label":"Alex Morgan","textValue":"Alex Morgan"},{"id":"item-2","value":"item-2","label":"Sam Rivera","textValue":"Sam Rivera"},{"id":"item-3","value":"item-3","label":"Taylor Kim","textValue":"Taylor Kim","disabled":true}]}>
      <AutocompleteLabel>Assign teammate</AutocompleteLabel>
      <AutocompleteControl>
        <AutocompleteInput placeholder="Search teammates…" />
        <AutocompleteClear type="button">×</AutocompleteClear>
      </AutocompleteControl>
      <AutocompletePositioner>
        <AutocompleteContent>
          <AutocompleteItem value="item-1">Alex Morgan</AutocompleteItem>
          <AutocompleteItem value="item-2">Sam Rivera</AutocompleteItem>
          <AutocompleteItem value="item-3">Taylor Kim</AutocompleteItem>
          <AutocompleteEmpty>No teammates found</AutocompleteEmpty>
        </AutocompleteContent>
      </AutocompletePositioner>
    </AutocompleteRoot>
  )
}

documentation.usageCode:
import {
  ToastViewport,
  ToastRoot,
  ToastTitle,
  ToastDescription,
  ToastAction,
  ToastClose,
} from '@uifn/components-react/toast'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ToastViewport toasts={[{"id":"item-1","title":"Changes published","description":"Your project is available to collaborators.","duration":null}]} duration={null} messages={{"dismissed":"Dismiss notification"}} aria-label="Toast example">
      <ToastRoot value="item-1">
        <ToastTitle value="item-1">Changes published</ToastTitle>
        <ToastDescription value="item-1">Your updates are now live.</ToastDescription>
        <ToastAction type="button" value="item-1">Undo</ToastAction>
        <ToastClose type="button" aria-label="Close" value="item-1">Close</ToastClose>
      </ToastRoot>
    </ToastViewport>
  )
}
